title: Reach Gate v1
description: Attestation-graph-aggregated reach level for content-node subjects. Four-node DAG: assemble → aggregate → (wisdom-edge →) synthesize. Fires on CapabilityInvoke { ReachNegotiation }. Emits Verdict(ReachLevel{ level }) with no side effects. The reach level reported (protocol / public / community / self-reach) is earned through distributed attestation recognition; callers decide promotion eligibility.
content:
# reach-gate-v1
# See gate-client/src/dag/reach_gate_v1.yaml for the canonical embedded source.
# This seed entry makes the reach gate discoverable as a ContentNode on the DHT.
#
# The authoritative YAML is embedded in the gate-client binary at compile time.
# This seed is a reference copy for DHT-based governance lookup (Phase 6+).
#
# Four-node DAG:
#   assemble (context-assemble)
#     └─ next ──► aggregate (aggregate-attestations, spec_cid: epr:specs:reach-v1)
#                     ├─ reachData.edge_case == true  ──► wisdom-edge (wisdom-invoke)
#                     └─ reachData.edge_case == false ──► synthesize (synthesize, Terminate)
#   wisdom-edge (wisdom-invoke) [Phase 5 DevContext: mocked Allow]
#     └─ next ──► synthesize
#   synthesize (synthesize) — verdict-from-reach builder
#     └─ (Terminate) Verdict(ReachLevel)
#
# ReachLevel values:
#   protocol   (≥50 attestations)
#   public     (≥20 attestations)
#   community  (≥5 attestations)
#   self-reach (<5 attestations — default)
